title: Turkey and Ham Sandwich on Wheat

content.title: About
content.content: Turkey and ham sandwich on wheat (1864) is a ready‑to‑eat sandwich made with sliced roasted turkey, ham, lettuce, tomato and a light mayo‑based sauce, placed between two slices of whole‑grain wheat bread.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The sandwich was first launched in 2021 as part of a quick‑lunch line.
Wheat bread provides slow‑release energy thanks to complex carbohydrates.
Turkey is one of the leanest meats, containing very little fat.
The ham used is smoked without added nitrites.
The product is packaged in a compostable, biodegradable wrapper.

items.title: Rich in protein
items.content: Turkey and ham together deliver about 20 g of protein per serving, supporting muscle maintenance.

items.title: Low in saturated fat
items.content: Lean turkey contains minimal saturated fat, making the sandwich heart‑friendly.

items.title: Source of B‑vitamins
items.content: Poultry provides vitamin B6 and niacin, which are important for metabolism.

items.title: Fiber from whole‑grain bread
items.content: Wheat bread adds dietary fiber, promoting digestive health.

items.title: Mild antioxidants
items.content: Tomato and lettuce supply lycopene and vitamin C, helping combat free radicals.

items.title: Allergy to poultry or pork
items.content: Individuals allergic to turkey or ham may experience reactions up to anaphylaxis.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Ham and sauce can raise sodium levels, so people with hypertension should monitor portion size.

items.title: Gluten
items.content: Wheat bread contains gluten, making the product unsuitable for those with celiac disease.

items.title: Preservatives
items.content: Some ham varieties may contain small amounts of preservatives; choose additive‑free versions if needed.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: The sandwich is ready to eat straight from the package. Optionally add mustard, crispy onions, or swap the sauce for a yogurt spread. For a warmer taste, microwave for 30‑40 seconds.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store refrigerated at 2‑4 °C and consume within 3 days. Once opened, eat within 24 hours. Discard if an off‑odor or discoloration appears.
